articles.title: Meet Barron Trump's college girlfriend — all we know about 6ft 9 student's life on campus
articles.summary: Donald Trump's son, Barron, reportedly has a college girlfriend and here's what we know about his love life
articles.body:
Barron Trump, son of US President Donald Trump, has reportedly been quietly dating a girlfriend he met at New York University for over a year now.

Barron transferred to NYU's DC campus in September 2026 to be closer to his parents, but it is unclear if he is still dating the woman.

Despite being described as shy and reserved, Barron Trump has shown a bold and entertaining personality, impressing guests at a dinner event in 2025.

Barron Trump , the 20-year-old son of the President of the United States, was perhaps the most eligible bachelor at New York University - until now!

The college student has reportedly found love with a girlfriend whom he met at college, with multiple outlets reporting that the pair have been quietly dating for over a year now

While not much is known about the woman in question, Barron spent the first year of college studying at New York University's Stern School of Business which is based on the Greenwich Village campus. He didn't live on campus but instead commuted from Trump Tower in Manhattan

In October 2024, Donald appeared on the PBD podcast and was quizzed over his son's love life, admitting at the time he was not sure Barron was "there yet," adding: " I don't think he's had a girlfriend yet."

However, in September 2026 it was confirmed that Barron had transferred to the school's DC campus for at least one semester to be closer to his mother and father. It is unclear if he is still dating the woman.

Interest in Barron's dating life began when a TikToker named Maddie said Barron was her "first BF" when they attended high school together.

She posted a video that featured clips of herself and Barron together, and claimed they'd broken up when Barron moved to attend St. Andrews Potomac in Virginia.

Barron has been linked to other 'girlfriends' in the past, including Sarah Claire and a model Klara Jones, who is two years older than him.

While Barron prefers to stay out of the spotlight, and has long been touted as "shy and reserved," it appears that is no longer the case. In 2025, Barron spoke about his father during a dinner at Mar-a-Lago and guests were blown away by his boldness.

American entrepreneur, Patrick Bet-David, attended the event, along with Tom Ellsworth and actor and comedian Vincent Oshana.

They dissected what they witnessed on an episode of Patrick's PBD podcast when they recalled watching "Barron run dinner with stories, entertainment, everything," for 90 minutes straight.

"I've never seen Tom laugh this hard for an hour and a half," Patrick said.

Vincent was left in awe of the teen's ability to keep the audience's attention and said: "He's 18. He's witty, smart, hilarious. He was smart on politics. He's like 'You know, everybody's always going to fight. There's left. There's right.'"

Vincent said Barron has a "good head on his shoulders." He was also branded: "Sharp, funny, sarcastic and tough."

Barron's first year in New York City was not the usual first year for a college students. Reports claimed that he was unable to make friends or enjoy a normal life as he was shadowed 24/7 by security and entered and exited the building through garages and secret doors.

Kaya Walker, the then-president of the NYU College Republicans, said in a 2025 interview that Barron was an "oddity" who "goes to class, he goes home." Other students claimed that they had invited him to pick-up basketball games and although he was interested he never confirmed plans.

articles.title: Roberta Miranda chega aos 70 anos, 40 deles como majestade que abriu alas na dinastia feminina do universo sertanejo | G1
articles.body:
Nascida em 28 de setembro de 1956, a cantora e compositora Roberta Miranda faz 70 anos hoje, segunda-feira — Foto: Reprodução / Instagram Roberta Miranda

♬ Roberta Miranda faz 70 anos hoje, segunda-feira, 28 de setembro. A data merece ser festejada como efeméride da música brasileira diante da importância da cantora e compositora paraibana no universo sertanejo.

Nascida Maria Albuquerque Miranda em João Pessoa (PB), em 28 de setembro de 1956, a artista adotou o nome artístico de Roberta Miranda ao iniciar a carreira fonográfica em 1986 com retumbante sucesso. Sim, dos 70 anos de vida da artista, 40 foram vividos no palco – outra efeméride, esta celebrada em cena pela cantora na turnê “A majestade”, recém-estreada em 19 de setembro, no Rio de Janeiro (RJ).

Sim, Roberta Miranda foi a primeira rainha na dinastia da música sertaneja, desbravando em carreira solo um território historicamente masculino e dominado por duplas formadas por homens. Roberta fez história no universo sertanejo porque extrapolou a função de cantora reservada até então às poucas intérpretes que desafiavam a hegemonia masculina.

Antes de conseguir lançar o primeiro disco, Roberta Miranda foi revelada como compositora em 1985, ano em que a canção “A majestade o sabiá” foi apresentada ao Brasil em álbum do cantor Jair Rodrigues (1939 – 2014), em gravação feita com participação da dupla Chitãozinho & Xororó. E foi como compositora que ela se impôs no mercado sertanejo, lançando álbuns que bateram venderam milhares de cópias entre 1986 e 1992, período áureo da discografia da artista.

A rigor, a primeira música de Roberta Miranda a ganhar registro fonográfico foi “Mãe guerreira”, lançada na voz do cantor Ruy Maurity (1949 – 2022) em 1984. Mas foi mesmo “A majestade o sabiá” a música que abriu as portas da indústria fonográfica para Roberta Miranda.

Em 1986, a artista debutou como cantora com “Roberta Miranda”, álbum blockbuster de repertório autoral que destacou as músicas “São tantas coisas” e “Meu dengo”, esta um baião de sensual pegada forrozeira que evidenciou a origem paraibana da artista.

Em 1987, o segundo álbum – também intitulado “Roberta Miranda”, mas popularmente conhecido como “Volume 2”, como andava a tradição fonográfica sertaneja da época – vendeu ainda mais do que o primeiro, no embalo do sucesso de músicas como “Vá com Deus”.

É fato que a obra autoral de Roberta Miranda não deu voz ativa às mulheres, como Marília Mendonça (1995 – 2021), futura rainha sertaneja, faria nos anos 2010, abrindo novas alas femininas no gênero.

A música de Roberta Miranda não explicitou o gênero feminino nas letras de canções como “Sol da minha vida” (1992). Tanto que um dos maiores sucessos do cancioneiro da compositora, “De igual para igual”, música composta em parceria com Matogrosso, foi lançada na voz do cantor José Augusto em 1987.

Nem por isso Roberta Miranda merece menos loas. Até porque a música da compositora sempre teve uma sensibilidade feminina captada pelo público, que avalizou de imediato a música feita por Roberta Miranda de um jeito particular.

E, cabe ressaltar, Roberta continua em plena atividade nos palcos e nos estúdios, sem nunca ter parado no tempo. Já adaptada ao modus operandi digital do mercado fonográfico, a cantora volta e meia lança single com música inédita. O último single solo, “Os meus 15 anos”, foi lançado em 31 de julho.

Roberta também soube se reinventar nas redes sociais, se posicionando geralmente sem filtro, como no post recente em que criticou o fato de o cantor Rick (1966 – 2026) ter ganhado mais de um milhão de seguidores após a morte em acidente de helicóptero.

Enfim, Roberta Miranda chega firme e forte aos 70 anos, ciente de que já tem um bom lugar todinho dela na história da música sertaneja.

articles.title: The Town 2027 anuncia Slipknot e Marilyn Manson como atrações | G1
articles.standfirst: Bandas se apresentarão no palco Skyline no dia 4 de setembro; festival volta a Interlagos, em São Paulo.
articles.summary: O festival The Town 2027 confirmou Slipknot e Marilyn Manson no palco Skyline para o dia 4 de setembro, marcando o retorno do evento ao Autódromo de Interlagos.
articles.body:
Slipknot e Marilyn Manson estarão no The Town 2027 — Foto: Flávio Moraes/G1 e AP

O The Town 2027 anunciou as duas primeiras atrações do festival: Slipknot e Marilyn Manson. Os dois se apresentarão no palco principal do evento, o Skyline, no dia 4 de setembro.

A apresentação do Slipknot vai integrar uma turnê global da banda, também anunciada nesta segunda-feira (28), e será a única realizada em um festival.

Chegando à sua terceira edição, o The Town acontecerá nos dias 4, 5, 6, 11 e 12 de setembro de 2027 no Autódromo de Interlagos, em São Paulo.

Ainda não há informações sobre venda de ingressos.

articles.title: 'Angikaaram' to 'Mango Pachcha': Check out the south Indian movies to watch on OTT this week
articles.summary: The latest South Indian OTT line-up brings together films from different genres and languages.
articles.body: The latest South Indian OTT line-up brings together films from different genres and languages. The selection includes supernatural mystery, sports drama, crime and romance. Telugu, Tamil and Kannada titles are among the movies available across major streaming platforms this week.For viewers looking for something new to stream this week, especially from South cinema, check out this list.'Agadha' brings supernatural mysteryTelugu movie 'Agadha' follows Mahadevi, a spiritually gifted exorcist whose life takes a disturbing turn after her cousin's mysterious death. She returns to her ancestral home while trying to understand what really happened.Her investigation eventually leads her deep into a forbidden forest. There, she comes across a mysterious cave and a twelve-handed idol. The film combines supernatural elements with a family mystery.'Agadha' started streaming on ZEE5 on September 25, 2026. ETimes gave the film only 2 stars out of 5 and our review read, "Agadha follows a familiar horror template but attempts to give it a fresh identity through its mythology, performances and CGI.While the first half builds genuine curiosity, the second half settles into a predictable narrative. Still, Sai Kamakshi Bhaskarla's performance, along with the strong potential shown by Jovika Vijayakumar, makes the film worth a watch for audiences who enjoy supernatural horror."M.S. Raju has directed the movie. The cast includes Kamakshi Bhaskarla, Shravan Reddy, Ulka Gupta and Jovika Vijaykumar.'Angikaaram' follows a sprinter's battleTamil movie 'Angikaaram' tells the story of Aathiran Banumathi, a 200-metre runner who comes from a Chennai slum. His sporting ability helps him secure a place at the Commonwealth Games.His achievement soon turns into a struggle when he discovers that his name has been removed from the roster. Instead of giving up his opportunity, Aathiran decides to challenge the decision. 'Angikaaram' is available to stream on SunNXT. The movie received a solid 2.5 star rating out of 5 from ETimes.'Mango Pachcha'Kannada movie 'Mango Pachcha' revolves around Prashanth, also known as Pachcha. He earns a living by running a video-rental shop in Mysuru. His circumstances change after he takes control of a secret marijuana-smuggling operation left behind by his late father. His involvement with a corrupt mayor takes him further into the criminal world.The movie explores how Prashanth's new circumstances begin to alter his life. Viveka has directed the crime drama, which features Sanchith Sanjeev, Kajal Kunder and Prashanth Hiremath. 'Mango Pachcha' started streaming on JioHotstar on September 25. ETimes rating for the film is 3 out of 5.'Habeebi'Tamil romantic drama 'Habeebi' centres on a young couple whose relationship creates tension within their Muslim community in southern Tamil Nadu. The story looks at the challenges faced by the couple as their relationship comes up against family expectations and established traditions. The movie also explores changing social dynamics within the community.Esha M, Malavika Manoj, Kasthuri Raja and Dhanashree Sudhakaran feature in the cast. VS Mohamed Ameen has written the movie, while Meera Kathiravan has directed it.'Habeebi' is currently streaming on SonyLIV and if you want to check out ETimes' review for the film, it says, "Habeebi is sincere and often lovely to look at, and viewers who know this world from the inside may find plenty to hold on to. For everyone else, the goodwill is easier to admire than to feel."Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection day 53 (LIVE): Vishal Chaturvedi's film earns Rs 17 lakhs on 8th Monday; India net reaches Rs 307.20 cr
articles.summary: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' has completed 53 days in theatres and continues its box office run.
articles.body: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' has completed 53 days in theatres and continues its box office run. The spiritual drama is currently showing across 1,069 shows on its eighth Monday.According to Sacnilk, 'Hanuman Ansh' has recorded a live India net collection of Rs 17 lakhs on Day 53. The film's total India net collection has now reached Rs 307.20 cr. Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 362.90 cr. The final collection for Day 53 is yet to be reported. The film has also crossed the Rs 400 cr mark in worldwide gross collections after completing 52 days in cinemas.Hanuman Ansh Day 53 collectionThe eighth Monday has seen a sharp drop in the film's daily collection. 'Hanuman Ansh' has so far earned Rs 17 lakhs in India net collection on September 28. The film is running across 1,069 shows, with its reported occupancy standing at 8.0%. Since the Day 53 figure remains live, the final number could change once the day's collection is updated.Hanuman Ansh sees weekend boostThe film had a strong eighth-weekend run before its Monday drop. On Day 50, September 25, 'Hanuman Ansh' collected Rs 3.35 cr from 3,767 shows. The reported occupancy was 21.0%. On September 26, the eighth Saturday, the film earned Rs 6.50 cr from 3,979 shows. Its occupancy stood at 37.0%. The collection peaked during this four-day period on Sunday. On September 27, 'Hanuman Ansh' recorded Rs 9.00 cr from 4,387 shows, with an occupancy of 46.0%.Hanuman Ansh week-wise collectionThe spiritual drama collected Rs 1.08 cr during its first week. Its second-week collection stood at Rs 40 lakhs. Week 3 added Rs 10.40 cr, followed by Rs 61.00 cr during the fourth week. The film then recorded Rs 90.25 cr in Week 5. During Week 6, 'Hanuman Ansh' added Rs 80.25 cr to its India net collection. Its seventh-week collection stood at Rs 44.80 cr. These week-wise collections helped the film cross the Rs 300 cr mark in India net earnings.Hanuman Ansh crosses Rs 400 cr worldwide'Hanuman Ansh' has reached another major milestone in its theatrical run. The film crossed Rs 400 cr in worldwide gross collections after completing 52 days in cinemas. The movie's India gross currently stands at Rs 362.90 cr. Its India net has reached Rs 307.20 cr based on the latest available figures.Hanuman Ansh box office reportThe eighth-weekend figures show a significant rise before the Monday decline. The film collected Rs 3.35 cr on Friday, Rs 6.50 cr on Saturday and Rs 9.00 cr on Sunday. The Day 53 figure is currently at Rs 17 lakhs, with 8.0% occupancy. The final collection for the eighth Monday is still awaited. Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' continues its theatrical run with the worldwide gross now above Rs 400 cr.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: ‘Avengers: Endgame’ retakes box office crown; Robert Pattinson drives sales for ‘Primetime’
articles.summary: Seven years after becoming the second-highest grossing film ever, “Avengers: Endgame” returned to the No. 1 spot at the box office in a victory lap for Marvel and an appetizer for the upcoming blockbuster “Avengers: Doomsday.”
articles.body: NEW YORK — Seven years after becoming the second-highest grossing film ever, “Avengers: Endgame” returned to the No. 1 spot at the box office in a victory lap for Marvel and an appetizer for the upcoming blockbuster “Avengers: Doomsday.” The rerelease grossed $26 million over the weekend and another $60 million overseas, according to studio estimates Sunday. The film, which grossed $2.8 billion in 2019, was put back into theaters with several new end-credits scenes and an introductory thank you to fans from Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans. Among rereleases, only the 1997 release of “Star Wars: A New Hope” ($35.9 million) and the 2011 repeat of “The Lion King” ($30.2 million) have opened higher than “Endgame” in domestic cinemas. Hollywood has increasingly turned to rereleases in recent years to take advantage of holes in the release schedule. But The Walt Disney Co. rerun, billed as “Endgame: Encore,” came out on top on an especially crowded weekend in theaters. Three well-reviewed new releases — A24’s “Primetime,” with Robert Pattinson; Paramount Pictures’ “Heart of the Beast,” with Brad Pitt; and Universal Pictures’ “Forgotten Island” — all landed in theaters. Second place, though, went to Zach Cregger’s reboot of “Resident Evil.” The Sony Pictures release followed up its above-expectations debut with $23.3 million in its second weekend. In two weeks, the video-game adaptation has grossed $103.5 million in U.S. and Canadian theaters. In a close race for third place, “Heart of the Beast” came out just ahead of “Primetime” with an estimated $20 million from 3,435 theaters. Directed by David Ayer, the film stars Pitt as a retired veteran who must trek through the Alaskan wilderness with his combat dog after a plane crash. It added $30.1 million in international theaters. Pattinson drives ‘Primetime’ sales But the opening for “Primetime” was more impressive. “Heart of the Beast” cost $82 million to produce, making its path to profitability challenging. “Primetime,” starring Pattinson as “To Catch a Predator” host Chris Hansen, was made with a modest budget of $15 million and it opened in 500 fewer theaters. Yet “Primetime,” buoyed by strong reviews and buzz out of the Venice Film Festival, debuted with $19.2 million. For Pattinson, who also starred this year in A24’s “The Drama” and Universal’s “The Odyssey,” the strong performance showed the actor’s drawing power with Gen Z audiences. Some 69% of ticket buyers for “Primetime” were under the age of 30. Gen Z has emerged as the most regular moviegoing demographic, fueling hits this year like “Obsession” and “Backrooms.” “Primetime” is directed by 30-year-old documentarian Lance Oppenheim, who co-directed the much-anticipated Elizabeth Holmes documentary, “You Can See Everything,” due out next month. “Forgotten Island,” from DreamWorks Animation, had a hard time standing out. The film, which cost $80 million to make, opened in fifth place with a disappointing $12.8 million domestically. In 31 overseas markets, “Forgotten Island” also didn’t make much of a dent, grossing $7.8 million internationally. Universal will hope family audiences catch up to the movie that landed the weekend’s best CinemaScore (an “A”) and the best reviews (94% fresh on Rotten Tomatoes). “Forgotten Island,” directed by Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado, is about two friends who get stranded in a mystical world. The confluence of releases added up to a historically good September weekend in theaters. According to Rentrak, ticket sales were up 58.5% from the same weekend last year. The domestic box office has massed $7.8 billion thus far, putting it 19% ahead of last year. Top 10 movies by domestic box office With final domestic figures being released Monday, this list factors in the estimated ticket sales for Friday through Sunday at U.S. and Canadian theaters, according to Rentrak: 1. “Avengers: Endgame: Encore,” $26 million. 2. “Resident Evil,” $23.3 million. 3. “Heart of the Beast,” $20 million. 4. “Primetime,” $19.2 million. 5. “Forgotten Island,” $12.8 million. 6. “Practical Magic 2,” $5.7 million. 7. “Spider-Man: Brand New Day,” $4.1 million. 8. “The Odyssey,” $3.7 million. 9. “Coyote vs. Acme,” $1.9 million. 10. “Daniel and the Fiery Furnace,” $1.5 million.

articles.title: Rakul Preet Singh, Vashu Bhagnani and Panorama Studios on Income Tax radar as department searches 12 Mumbai locations over alleged overseas fund transactions
articles.summary: The Income Tax Department is conducting searches at multiple Mumbai locations associated with actor Rakul Preet Singh, film producer Vashu Bhagnani and
articles.body: The Income Tax Department is conducting searches at multiple Mumbai locations associated with actor Rakul Preet Singh, film producer Vashu Bhagnani and Panorama Studios. The operation is reportedly connected to an investigation into suspected financial irregularities involving film-related transactions and the alleged movement of funds overseas.According to a report by NDTV, officials from the Mumbai Income Tax Department are carrying out searches at 12 locations. Teams are examining financial documents, transaction records and other material as they investigate allegations that money linked to film financing may have been transferred abroad.Financial records under scrutinyThe ongoing operation involves multiple Income Tax teams checking documents and financial records at premises associated with the individuals and company named in the reports.The department is reportedly looking into overseas transactions connected with film projects, although specific details about the payments or the alleged irregularities have not been disclosed so far. The examination of records is expected to establish the nature and purpose of the transactions under investigation.A search by the Income Tax Department does not by itself establish wrongdoing, and the investigation is still underway.Aman Preet Singh was named in a drug case in 2025The latest Income Tax action comes after a separate case involving Rakul’s family last year. In December 2025, Mumbai Police reportedly searched for her brother Aman Preet Singh in connection with a drug-related investigation.The development followed an operation carried out by the Elite Action Group for Drug Law Enforcement (EAGLE) Force along with West Zone police on December 19, 2025. Two businessmen were arrested during the operation on allegations of drug peddling.According to reports, police recovered 43 grams of cocaine and 11.5 grams of MDMA from the two accused. Aman was suspected of having allegedly purchased drugs from them on five occasions. The drug case and the current Income Tax investigation are separate matters.Rakul Preet Singh’s upcoming projectsOn the film front, Rakul is set to appear as Surpanakha in Nitesh Tiwari’s ‘Ramayana’. The actor has recently started dubbing for the film ahead of its Diwali 2026 release.The mythological epic features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman.Vashu Bhagnani’s production bannerVashu Bhagnani has been associated with Puja Films for several years, with the production house now being led by his son Jackky Bhagnani. The banner has worked across theatrical releases, digital projects and other entertainment ventures.Its recent theatrical release was ‘Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai’.As the Income Tax Department continues examining the financial records connected with the current searches, further details about the transactions under investigation are awaited.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: King Charles, Prince William 'furious' as Princess Diana's brother unleashes explosive claims: experts
articles.summary: Charles Spencer's "Swan Song" reopens royal family wounds with claims about Princess Diana's funeral that have rattled Buckingham Palace insiders.
articles.body: King Charles III and Prince William are said to be furious at Charles Spencer's new book, which makes damning allegations about the monarch and reopens decades-old wounds within the royal family. The claim was made by several royal experts who spoke to Fox News Digital after "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" was published on Tuesday. In it, Princess Diana's brother says he argued with then-Prince Charles over palace plans to have William and Prince Harry, then 15 and 12, walk behind their mother's coffin during her 1997 funeral procession. Most notably, Spencer alleged that after Diana died at age 36 in a car crash, Charles "sounded giddily elated — like a lottery winner." He wrote that Charles "went ballistic" during an argument they had over William and Harry. Spencer said Charles then hissed, "Rest assured, we'll forget her soon enough." KING CHARLES RESPONDS TO CHARLES SPENCER'S CLAIMS ABOUT PRINCESS DIANA IN A RARE STATEMENT "What I am hearing concerning the reaction around both households is frustration and anger, but for slightly different reasons," Kinsey Schofield, host of YouTube's "Kinsey Schofield Unfiltered," told Fox News Digital. "For the king, I think there is genuine anger at what amounts to an attack on his character almost 30 years after Diana's death," she explained. "But Charles has also lived with being cast as the villain in the Diana story for decades. Unfortunately, being portrayed as the bad guy in somebody else's version of this story is not new territory for him. For Prince William, there is an additional sense of betrayal. This is his uncle, who famously stood at Diana's funeral and promised that her 'blood family' would protect William and Harry." Fox News may be compensated for or earn a commission if you buy through our referral links. "William now has to watch that same uncle reopen some of the most traumatic events of his childhood and hear extremely damaging allegations against his father," Schofield said. WATCH: KING CHARLES FACES RENEWED ROYAL DRAMA OVER SPENCER MEMOIR: EXPERT "And William isn't just Charles' son. He is the future king. The monarchy Charles Spencer is attacking is the institution William will inherit. William is also reasonably questioning how dredging up disputed private conversations from 30 years ago, attacking the current king and reigniting the ugliest chapters of the Charles and Diana story could be in his nephew's best interests." After excerpts from the book were published last week, Buckingham Palace issued a rare, strongly worded statement. "His Majesty is mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and color memory in ways others do not recognize, even many years after such a loss," it said. A spokesperson for Buckingham Palace told Fox News Digital it had no comment. A spokesperson for Kensington Palace previously told Fox News Digital the palace does not comment on books. Spencer has stood by his account, insisting to the BBC that he is telling the truth. He asked, "Is he furious or is he embarrassed?" Some critics have questioned why Spencer felt the need to revisit the pain and trauma nearly 30 years later, The Associated Press reported. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Spencer said he wanted to write down his own thoughts and memories about Diana, "once and for all, rather than having the discomfort of again reading the opinions of others, many of which are based on untruths." Author Christopher Andersen told Fox News Digital he was surprised by Spencer's allegations. "Just weeks after Diana was killed, I interviewed hundreds of sources in London and Paris for my book 'The Day Diana Died,'" he said. "They all remembered that Charles was absolutely devastated. 'Crushed' was a word I heard repeatedly when he first learned the news of Diana's death. After years of famously battling as a married couple, they had finally found a kind of peace with each other following their 1996 divorce. They actually became friends." "When Charles got the call at Balmoral that Diana had been killed, a staffer told me that the king let out a howl that sounded like a wounded animal, then burst into tears. Others described Charles at the time as being racked with sobs, his face streaked with tears." "I also interviewed the nurses at the Paris hospital who witnessed the moment Charles saw Diana's body for the first time," Andersen continued. "He fell back, one of them told me, as if he had been struck by an unseen hand. They thought he was going to pass out. He then began to weep openly. Everyone was very surprised at how emotional King Charles was because they believed members of the royal family, and especially Charles, were cold and aloof. They did not doubt in their minds that he was shattered by his ex-wife's tragic death." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Andersen said he wonders whether the words Spencer says he heard from Charles over the phone were those of "a man on the verge of a nervous breakdown." "King Charles' world was crumbling all around him," Andersen said. "Not only was the mother of his children suddenly gone, but at the time, Queen Elizabeth did not want the princess to have a public funeral. She refused to fly the flag at half-staff over Buckingham Palace in Diana's honor. She did not even want to come back from her summer vacation at Balmoral. It fell on Charles' shoulders to force his mother to show Diana the respect the British people felt she deserved." Still, Andersen said he would not be surprised if the king had shouted hurtful words at Spencer in anger. "Charles has a long history of lashing out, making rash and sometimes cruel, offhand statements," Andersen said. "The king always resented being overshadowed by Diana during her lifetime, and now he was being totally eclipsed by her in death. There was lingering resentment there. It's also clear the king knew that the public would blame him and Camilla for making Diana so desperately unhappy during her lifetime and, to some extent, for the extent, for the events leading up to her death." Andersen noted that the late queen "was in no mood" to see her eldest son remarry anytime soon. Any hopes Charles may have had of marrying Camilla, with whom he had previously had an affair, were dashed. Eight years passed before the queen permitted Charles to marry Camilla. A source told Radar Online that Queen Camilla is trying to "lower the temperature" behind palace doors. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "She doesn't believe anything is gained by continually reopening old wounds or allowing deeply personal disagreements about the past to develop into an increasingly hostile public battle," the insider told the outlet. "Camilla is particularly conscious that there are different memories of what happened during an extraordinarily difficult period for the family. People experienced those events from very different perspectives, and she recognizes that emotions surrounding Diana are still exceptionally powerful." British royal expert Hilary Fordwich told Fox News Digital that William isn't close to his uncle and that sources have told her he is "absolutely furious." "His public silence regarding this matter is admirable," she said. "The pain Spencer is causing William has backfired as he’s being accused of monetizing his sister’s memory." British broadcaster and photographer Helena Chard told Fox News Digital that Buckingham Palace is "rattled, but they're not panicking" over Spencer's "verbal grenades straight at the palace gates." She said the royal family is privately presenting a united front as its members focus on their duties. "The strategy is clear: let the book have a few weeks of noisy publicity and just plow on with the job," Chard said. "Sources say King Charles is saddened, yet angry, and sort of feels like a lamb to the slaughter facing never-ending character assassination. For Prince William, the pain cuts slightly deeper. It's trauma stirred anew. Palace aides say his focus is on public work and protecting the family." PRINCESS DIANA'S BROTHER CHARLES SPENCER SAYS KING CHARLES 'GASLIT' HIM OVER MEMOIR CLAIMS "Whatever you think of Prince Harry's memoir, Harry was King Charles' son, Prince William's brother and a central participant in the family life he was describing," Schofield said. "Charles Spencer simply did not have that same proximity to the royal family or even, according to multiple accounts, to Diana throughout the final years of her life. There have been people within Diana's circle who have challenged the impression that Charles Spencer was this constant, intimate presence in her life." Spencer has stood by his account as the book rolls out globally and is translated into 12 languages.

articles.title: In 1992, Arnold Schwarzenegger wanted to give children a safe place after school; 34 years later, his initiative serves over 140,000 students
articles.summary: Long before Arnold Schwarzenegger became California’s governor, he was already working on an issue involving children and the hours they spent outside
articles.body: Long before Arnold Schwarzenegger became California’s governor, he was already working on an issue involving children and the hours they spent outside school. In 1992, Schwarzenegger and Danny Hernandez founded the Inner-City Games Foundation, an initiative that brought sports and fitness activities to young people in under-resourced communities.More than three decades later, that initiative has evolved into After-School All-Stars (ASAS), a national nonprofit providing free after-school and summer programmes. According to its latest figures, the organisation now reaches 140,833 students annually through 754 sites across 77 US cities.The organisation’s beginnings were rooted in the idea that children’s lives did not stop when the school bell rang. Its early programmes used sports and physical activities to provide young people with organised experiences during after-school hours.The Los Angeles chapter was established in 1992, and the organisation received its official 501(c)(3) nonprofit designation the following year. Over the next few years, chapters were established in cities including Atlanta, Las Vegas, Orlando, New York City and San Diego.From sports programmes to broader education supportThe initiative gradually became more ambitious. In 2003, the Inner-City Games expanded its mission to comprehensive, school-based programming and adopted the name After-School All-Stars.Its work now extends well beyond athletics. ASAS offers programmes covering academic support, STEM, visual and performing arts, health and wellness, and career exploration. Students can take part in activities ranging from homework assistance and coding to music, sports, cooking and career-focused experiences.The organisation also introduced programmes aimed at helping teenagers prepare for life beyond school. CampUS, launched in 2010, focused on high school and college success, while STEM CampUs followed in 2013 with activities connected to fields including engineering, graphic design and applied sciences. The same year, ASAS launched its national Youth Advisory Board, giving participating students a role in shaping programmes and community-service initiatives. The organisation reported serving 95,502 students in 2012. By 2021, its summer programming had expanded to 212 sites and reached nearly 11,000 students.In 2002, while campaigning in California, he backed Proposition 49, the After School Education and Safety Act. California voters approved the measure, which provided $550 million for after-school programmes for students in kindergarten through ninth grade, according to the ASAS timeline and the USC Schwarzenegger Institute.The USC Schwarzenegger Institute has also reported that Schwarzenegger spent $2.3 million of his own money supporting the campaign for the measure. His advocacy continued after his time in California politics. At the 2017 National Afterschool Summit, Schwarzenegger urged leaders to oppose proposed federal cuts to after-school funding and described the period between 3 p.m. and 6 p.m. as a particularly important period for young people.“This is not a party issue, this is a people’s issue,” Schwarzenegger said at the summit. During the event, he also referred to concerns raised by law enforcement about young people being exposed to drugs, alcohol, gangs and violence during unsupervised after-school hours.The organisation’s reach continues to expandASAS has continued adding academic, career, health and enrichment opportunities to its programmes. Its current work is spread across schools and other community locations, including recreation centres and housing authorities.The organisation’s FY24 annual report highlighted programmes operating at 740 sites, with nearly 150,000 students participating during that year. Its financial timeline also states that annual revenue crossed $100 million in 2024, rising from $91.5 million in 2023 to $104.7 million, with the organisation reporting that 89% of revenue went directly to programmes.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Rosie O’Donnell rips Ed Sheeran for ‘siding with billionaire elite,’ accuses him of ‘supporting genocide’
articles.summary: Rosie O'Donnell accused Ed Sheeran of siding with Robert Kraft and of "supporting genocide" after Macklemore was dropped from the "Loop Tour."
articles.body: Rosie O'Donnell blasted New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft and singer Ed Sheeran on Friday during an appearance on Ireland's "The Late Late Show," accusing Sheeran of making a "very bad mistake" after Macklemore was removed from his U.S. tour following the rapper's pro-Palestinian performances. O’Donnell made the accusation after host Patrick Kielty asked about the controversy surrounding Kraft, Sheeran and Macklemore. "I think Ed Sheeran made a very bad mistake and that he will come to understand the ramifications of siding with a billionaire elite, in supporting genocide rather than the people who are saying, 'This is wrong. We will not stand for it. We are human beings and each human life matters and that's what's the most important thing,'" O’Donnell said. LIBERAL LAWMAKERS, ACTIVISTS RALLY BEHIND MACKLEMORE AFTER SHEERAN TOUR REMOVAL OVER 'FREE PALESTINE' STANCE "Hollywood in Toto" host Christian Toto said celebrities face pressure within the entertainment industry to adopt a particular position on the Israel-Palestinian conflict and compared the dynamic to the entertainment industry’s response to Black Lives Matter. "There is only one acceptable answer for celebrities when it comes to the ongoing Israel/Palestinian conflict. Say 'Free Palestine' and nothing else," Toto told Fox News Digital in comments Sunday. "It's the new BLM, a contentious issue where celebrities know they'll gain approval within their circle by repeating that mantra. They also understand they won't be pressured to defend their point of view by the vast majority of entertainment reporters. It's a safe space for them. Journalists now know they can pepper stars with similar questions and get a similar response (and lots of clicks for their interviews)." "Most artists know better than to alienate audiences with their political views," he continued. "The Springsteens, Morellos and Macklemores remain the exception. Concert ticket prices are too high for most bands to get on their soapbox and risk dooming repeat business. Actors don't make the connection between their divisive words and audience reaction. They simply want to appease their fellow actors and make nice with potential directors and casting directors. So they read from the approved script." ED SHEERAN FACES GROWING BACKLASH AS RADIO STATION BANS SONGS, PROTEST GROUPS RESPOND TO MACKLEMORE'S REMOVAL O'Donnell directly targeted Kraft, who owns Gillette Stadium and founded the Foundation to Combat Antisemitism, after Kielty referenced Kraft's role in opposing Macklemore's appearance at the venue. "Well, he's part of the billionaire elite," she said. "Those are the most corrupt people in the United States right now. And they have sort of performed a coup on the American government. And it's very tragic." Nick Fondacaro, associate editor for NewsBusters, reacted to O'Donnell's comments, saying, "Are we surprised that an unabashed 9/11-truther took an irrational and unhinged position?" "It’s irresponsible and incendiary to claim a coup has taken place in America, especially when political violence is on the rise. Given that people like Charlie Kirk and Brian Thompson have been killed by leftists for their political causes, Rosie’s prediction that Sheeran will come to learn a lesson sounded like a warning or threat," he continued. "It’s hypocritical that a multimillionaire like Rosie things that Robert Kraft didn’t have the same rights as she and Macklemore. The stadium is his property, and he can decide who to allow in or not, just like they can bar Kraft from their multimillion-dollar mansions." Macklemore was dropped from Sheeran's "Loop Tour" after repeatedly saying "Free Palestine" and performing "Hind's Hall" during shows at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. The rapper alleged Kraft told Sheeran he would not be permitted to perform at Gillette Stadium and rallied other venue owners against his continued participation. Tour promoter Messina Touring Group said venues had informed them they would not allow concerts to proceed with Macklemore on the lineup. ROBERT KRAFT, GILLETTE STADIUM BOOT MACKLEMORE FROM ED SHEERAN TOUR OVER ‘FREE PALESTINE’ RANT Kraft defended his position by citing what he described as Macklemore's "broader history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery," while stressing that his decision was not intended to dismiss Palestinian suffering. Kraft said support for Palestinians and opposition to Hamas and antisemitism were compatible positions. "Standing with the Palestinian people and standing against Hamas, antisemitism and hate should not be mutually exclusive," Kraft said. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE Sheeran has also publicly rejected the implication that he supports the suffering of Palestinians. During his first concert after the controversy, Fox News Digital reported from Philadelphia that Sheeran condemned Hamas’ Oct. 7 attack while also criticizing the scale of civilian suffering in Gaza. "What is happening in Gaza is catastrophic and unjustifiable and disproportionate," Sheeran said. Sheeran also pledged $2 million toward humanitarian relief and asked Kraft to match the contribution. Kraft agreed, saying he had spent decades supporting programs bringing Palestinians and Israelis together. Macklemore separately pledged the $1 million he said he earned from the tour to Palestinian aid organizations. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Fox News Digital reached out to Kraft, Sheeran and Macklemore for comment, but did not immediately receive a response.

articles.title: Matthew Stafford makes surprise cameo in Taylor Swift’s ‘Patient Zero’ music video
articles.summary: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford made a surprise appearance in Taylor Swift's music video for 'Patient Zero', premiered at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards. Find out how this crossover event links the NFL to Swift's music world.
articles.body: Matthew Stafford had a very different kind of spotlight waiting for him before his Sunday Night Football game. The Los Angeles Rams quarterback made a surprise appearance in Taylor Swift’s ‘Patient Zero’ music video, which premiered during the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards on Sunday, September 27, 2026. The cameo caught fans off guard, especially because Stafford’s appearance was not revealed in the first teaser for the video.Taylor Swift’s new music video stars Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell, with the singer herself also appearing throughout the dark, cinematic story. Stafford and his wife, Kelly Stafford, also make brief appearances in the video.Matthew Stafford appears in Taylor Swift’s ‘Patient Zero’ music videoMatthew Stafford pops up several times in the video. In one scene, he is seen shaking hands with Colin Farrell’s character, while another shot shows him standing alongside the actor on a stage. The Rams quarterback also appears in the background dancing with his wife, Kelly Stafford. The surprise cameo was first reported after the video premiered at the 2026 MTV VMAs. USA TODAY noted that fans were initially expecting to see mainly Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell after Swift’s first teaser was released.Why was Matthew Stafford in Taylor Swift’s ‘Patient Zero’ video?The cameo also makes sense when you look at Matthew Stafford’s connection to Swift and her wider circle. Matthew and Kelly Stafford were among the celebrities who attended Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding earlier this summer. The Rams quarterback is also one of the biggest names in Los Angeles sports, making his appearance a fun crossover between the NFL and Swift’s music world.Stafford’s cameo also contained a little Easter egg of its own. Fans connected his appearance to the word “Aries” from Swift’s earlier ‘Law & Order’-themed sketch, with Aries being the zodiac sign associated with the ram a nod to the Los Angeles Rams. Swifties quickly picked up on the clue after the music video premiered.Taylor Swift’s ‘Patient Zero’ video stars Dakota Johnson and Colin FarrellThe main story of ‘Patient Zero’ centres on Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell. Johnson plays a woman who becomes involved with Farrell’s character, while Swift appears as his former wife. The video has a dark, almost gothic feel, mixing elements of a psychological thriller, ghost story and true crime.The story eventually reveals a much darker twist involving Farrell’s character and Swift’s death. Swift has said the video allowed her to explore several genres she enjoys. In an Instagram post after the premiere, she explained that the house featured in the video was also meant to represent “the coldness of a relationship that’s faded and atrophied.”Cara Delevingne also makes a brief appearance in the music video‘Patient Zero’ premiered at the 2026 MTV VMAs. Taylor Swift premiered ‘Patient Zero’ at the MTV Video Music Awards on September 27, 2026, shortly after accepting the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors. The video was part of a particularly big night for Swift, who also received multiple nominations at the 2026 ceremony. The song itself was released on September 25, 2026, as part of ‘The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore’, which features four additional tracks: ‘Patient Zero’, ‘Cleveland!’, ‘Pink Clouding’ and ‘Babylon’. Matthew Stafford makes NFL history after Taylor Swift cameo.Matthew Stafford’s Taylor Swift cameo was only one part of a very busy Sunday for the quarterback. Just hours after appearing in the ‘Patient Zero’ music video, Stafford took the field with the Los Angeles Rams against the Denver Broncos on Sunday Night Football. During the game, he became the first quarterback in NFL history to throw for more than 20,000 passing yards with two different teams. Stafford had previously crossed the 20,000-yard mark during his time with the Detroit Lions in 2014. He reached the milestone with the Rams during the Broncos game after completing a 15-yard pass to wide receiver Konata Mumpfield in the second quarter.The milestone came despite a difficult night for Stafford and the Rams. He finished with 390 passing yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions as Los Angeles eventually lost 30-26 to Denver.Within the space of a few hours, Stafford went from appearing alongside Taylor Swift and Colin Farrell in a major new music video to making NFL history on Sunday Night Football.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Sai Pallavi to Karthi: 5 South stars whose impressive educational degrees may surprise you
articles.summary: Though many performers start their careers in movies when they are still young, there are also South Indian celebrities who were not only successful but
articles.body: Though many performers start their careers in movies when they are still young, there are also South Indian celebrities who were not only successful but had great educational credentials as well. They studied such varied subjects as medicine, law, engineering, and even literature before they started making movies or parallel to their careers in cinema.Sai Pallavi - MBBS graduate who became a leading actressSai Pallavi is among the famous South Indian actresses who had a medical degree. She studied MBBS at Tbilisi State Medical University in Georgia and graduated in 2016. She later cleared the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) in India. Despite completing her medical education, she went on to build a successful career in films.Mammootty - Actor who studied law and practised as a lawyerMalayalam superstar Mammootty has a LL.B degree from Government Law College, Ernakulam. Before making acting his full-time career, he practised law for around two years. His legal background is one of the lesser-known aspects of the actor’s life. He later established himself as one of Malayalam cinema’s most celebrated stars.Karthi - Engineer with a master’s degree from the USTamil actor Karthi has an educational background in engineering and management. He completed his B.E. in Mechanical Engineering from Crescent Engineering College in Chennai. He later moved to the US and pursued a master’s degree in Industrial Engineering from Binghamton University. Before entering films, he also worked in the US and explored a career outside cinema.Rashmika Mandanna - Studied psychology, journalism and English literatureRashmika Mandanna pursued her college education at M.S. Ramaiah College in Bengaluru. She studied Psychology, Journalism and English Literature as part of her bachelor’s degree. Her academic interests were in fields that are quite different from her eventual career in films. She later entered the entertainment industry and became a prominent name across South Indian cinema.Suresh Gopi - Postgraduate in English literatureVeteran Malayalam actor Suresh Gopi also has a strong academic qualification. He holds a master’s degree in English Literature from Fathima Mata National College in Kollam. His postgraduate education came before his long-running career in Malayalam cinema. Apart from acting, he has also been involved in television and public life over the years.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
